title: Binance Will Add Vaulta (A) on Earn, Buy Crypto, Convert, Margin & Futures
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  Vaulta (A)  will be added to  Binance Simple Earn ,  "Buy Crypto" ,  Binance Convert ,  Binance Margin , and  Binance Futures  at the respective dates and timings listed below. Earn A Flexible Products and Locked Products  will be listed on Binance Simple Earn at  2025-05-28 08:00 (UTC)  and will be  available for subscription . Details on  A Locked Products  subscriptions can be found in the table below: Digital Asset Duration Standard APR Min. Subscription Limit per User Max. Subscription Limit per User A 30 days 3.9% 1 A 1,000,000 A 60 days 5% 1 A 400,000 A 90 days 6% 1A 400,000 A 120 days 7.5% 1 A 200,000 A Buy & Sell Crypto Users can buy  A  with  VISA, MasterCard, Google Pay, Apple Pay, Revolut  or buy and sell  A  with their  account balances  on the “ Buy Crypto ” page, available within one hour of  A  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Convert Users will be able to start trading  A  against BTC, USDT, and any other tokens on  Binance Convert  at  zero fees  within one hour of  A  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Margin Binance Margin will add  A  as a new borrowable asset on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as the  A/USDT  pair on Cross and Isolated Margin at  2025-05-27 08:00 (UTC). Notes:  Please note that newly listed tokens tend to be volatile; users are encouraged to adopt stringent risk management strategies when trading such tokens. Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates. Futures Binance Futures will launch the  USDⓈ-M A Perpetual Contract  at  2025-05-28 08:00 (UTC) , with up to 75x leverage.  More details on the USDⓈ-M A Perpetual Contract can be found in the table below: USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract AUSDT Launch Time  2025-05-28 08:00 (UTC) Underlying Asset Vaulta (A) Settlement Asset USDT Tick Size 0.00001 Capped Funding Rate +2.00% / -2.00% Funding Fee Settlement Frequency Every Four Hours Maximum Leverage 75x Trading Hours 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Please Note:  The maximum funding rate of the AUSDT Perpetual Contract at the time of launch is +2.00% / -2.00%.  The funding fee settlement frequency is  every four hours . Time Max Funding Rate 2025-05-28 12:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-05-28 16:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-05-28 20:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-05-29 00:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% … … The aforementioned perpetual contract will be made available for Futures Copy Trading within 24 hours of launch. For more information on available Futures Copy Trading contracts, please refer to  this FAQ . Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the AUSDT Perpetual Contract from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the AUSDT Perpetual Contract across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the AUSDT Perpetual Contract.  The AUSDT Perpetual Contract is subject to the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement .
